title: AI as a deliberative partner fosters intercultural empathy for Americans but fails for Latin American participants.

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting an online dialogue experiment where American and Latin American participants interact with an LLM explicitly prompted to represent their own or another culture's perspectives. Bias is measured through real-time emotional feedback (emojis), post-chat surveys on intercultural empathy, and participant-driven tagging/qualitative feedback evaluating the AI's cultural authenticity (e.g., tagging responses as 'culturally unknowledgeable' or 'factually incorrect').

Comparing the performance and perceived authenticity of an AI deliberative partner when it is prompted to represent the United States versus specific Latin American countries (Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Nicaragua), evaluated through native-user feedback.
